description: Shows your user a project's screens inline, in canvas order. They can enlarge a screen, add screens to this chat, and open the project in Sleek. After a design run completes, call it with that runId to show what the run made. Where the client cannot show apps, this returns the screen names only; use screenshot to see the screens. Returns the screen names and ids, the same ones design takes as screenId.

projectId.description: Project id from an item's id in list_projects, or data.id in create_project.

runId.description: Run id from data.runId in a design result. Marks the screens that run changed.

name: show_project

projectUrl.description: Open link for the project. Share it with your user.

runStatus.description: Status of the run named by runId, when one was given.

screenCount.description: How many screens the project has, including any not listed.

screens.description: The project's screens in canvas order, up to 200. Every screen the runId run changed is listed.

screenId.description: Pass to design as screenId to edit this screen.

title: Show a project's screens
